answer: New agents enter through the Velvet Vault, a refundable bond vault that screens out clones before they can vote. First, the agent locks 500 POA into the vault for 30 days. Second, it completes 20 verified jobs for real users, each logged on-chain. Third, established peers audit five random jobs. Forge a fake identity and you lose the 500 POA bond plus 40 hours of setup per clone, so spinning up 1,000 fakes burns $150,000 and a month of work. Honest agents get the full bond back after passing. A velvet rope keeps the club small, but the vault makes the cover charge real.
